import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import datetime
import matplotlib.dates as mdates

# New expectations from upstream PR #21568 (the graders' FAIL_TO_PASS tests)
fmt_cases = [
    (datetime.timedelta(weeks=52 * 200),
     [r'$\mathdefault{%d}$' % year for year in range(1990, 2171, 20)]),
    (datetime.timedelta(days=30),
     [r'$\mathdefault{1990{-}01{-}%02d}$' % day for day in range(1, 32, 3)]),
    (datetime.timedelta(hours=20),
     [r'$\mathdefault{01{-}01\;%02d}$' % hour for hour in range(0, 21, 2)]),
    (datetime.timedelta(minutes=10),
     [r'$\mathdefault{01\;00{:}%02d}$' % minu for minu in range(0, 11)]),
]
ok = True
for delta, expected in fmt_cases:
    d1 = datetime.datetime(1990, 1, 1)
    d2 = d1 + delta
    locator = mdates.AutoDateLocator(interval_multiples=False)
    locator.create_dummy_axis()
    locator.axis.set_view_interval(mdates.date2num(d1), mdates.date2num(d2))
    formatter = mdates.AutoDateFormatter(locator, usetex=True)
    got = [formatter(loc) for loc in locator()]
    good = got == expected
    ok = ok and good
    print(('PASS' if good else 'FAIL'), 'AutoDateFormatter', delta)

concise_cases = [
    (datetime.timedelta(weeks=52 * 200),
     ['$\\mathdefault{%d}$' % (t,) for t in range(1980, 2201, 20)]),
    (datetime.timedelta(days=40),
     ['Jan', '$\\mathdefault{05}$', '$\\mathdefault{09}$',
      '$\\mathdefault{13}$', '$\\mathdefault{17}$', '$\\mathdefault{21}$',
      '$\\mathdefault{25}$', '$\\mathdefault{29}$', 'Feb',
      '$\\mathdefault{05}$', '$\\mathdefault{09}$']),
    (datetime.timedelta(hours=40),
     ['Jan$\\mathdefault{{-}01}$', '$\\mathdefault{04{:}00}$',
      '$\\mathdefault{08{:}00}$', '$\\mathdefault{12{:}00}$',
      '$\\mathdefault{16{:}00}$', '$\\mathdefault{20{:}00}$',
      'Jan$\\mathdefault{{-}02}$', '$\\mathdefault{04{:}00}$',
      '$\\mathdefault{08{:}00}$', '$\\mathdefault{12{:}00}$',
      '$\\mathdefault{16{:}00}$']),
    (datetime.timedelta(seconds=2),
     ['$\\mathdefault{59.5}$', '$\\mathdefault{00{:}00}$',
      '$\\mathdefault{00.5}$', '$\\mathdefault{01.0}$',
      '$\\mathdefault{01.5}$', '$\\mathdefault{02.0}$',
      '$\\mathdefault{02.5}$']),
]
for t_delta, expected in concise_cases:
    d1 = datetime.datetime(1997, 1, 1)
    d2 = d1 + t_delta
    locator = mdates.AutoDateLocator(interval_multiples=True)
    locator.create_dummy_axis()
    locator.axis.set_view_interval(mdates.date2num(d1), mdates.date2num(d2))
    formatter = mdates.ConciseDateFormatter(locator, usetex=True)
    got = formatter.format_ticks(locator())
    good = got == expected
    ok = ok and good
    print(('PASS' if good else 'FAIL'), 'ConciseDateFormatter', t_delta)
    if not good:
        print('  got     :', got[:4])
        print('  expected:', expected[:4])

print('RESULT:', 'ALL PASS' if ok else 'SOME FAIL')
